h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kalyan Dombivli

items.pText: Kalyan and Dombivli sit about 28 km from our factory in Vasai, which makes the twin city one of the closest large markets we serve. FunPlay Systems has made outdoor playground equipment since 2002. Every slide, swing and play tower for Kalyan Dombivli is built in our own 45,000 sq ft unit and then travels by road to your site.

Most enquiries from here come from builders finishing new towers, from older societies that are being redeveloped and want a fresh garden, and from schools along the Central Railway line. We help each of them choose equipment, mark the safe play area on a layout drawing and install the pieces with our own team. Most projects start with a phone call and a few photos.

richText.heading: Play areas for new towers in Kalyan and Dombivli

c: Many new projects in Kalyan West, Dombivli East and along the Kalyan Shil Road keep the children's area on a podium or in a narrow strip between buildings. A podium slab cannot be dug for foundations, so we use the self-standing method there and lay rubber flooring on top. On open ground we grout the posts into concrete.
For tight spaces, a compact unit from our
Play Lands multi play stations
puts slides, a climber and a deck into one footprint. Builders like that it photographs well for the sales brochure and is ready before possession.

Kalyan Dombivli gets heavy rain from June to September, and low ground near the Ulhas river and the creek can hold water for days. Raise the play area a little above the garden level and give it a slope towards a drain. Galvanised steel posts and roto-moulded plastic parts cope well with months of wet weather, because the zinc coating protects the steel and plastic does not rust.
After the rains, check bolts and spring riders, and wash off the silt that settles on slides. Our after sales team can guide your society staff on these checks.

items: Builders who need a finished play area at handover.
Housing societies in Dombivli and Kalyan that are replacing old metal swings.
Schools that want equipment for nursery and primary sections on one ground.

c: Gardens run by the Kalyan-Dombivli Municipal Corporation also need pieces that can take crowds every evening. For adults and senior citizens in the same garden, see our
outdoor gym equipment in Kalyan Dombivli
Many older societies in Dombivli still have rusted swings and broken slides. We can plan new pieces that use the same open space and keep the garden in use during the change.
We have installed play equipment for
Raymond in Thane

, a short drive from Kalyan. A Kalyan Dombivli project follows the same steps. You send the site size, the age group and a few photos, we send a layout and a quote, and once you approve, we manufacture, dispatch and install.
Because the distance is short, it is easy for your committee or site engineer to plan the installation day around other work on the site.

items.q: How far is your factory from Kalyan Dombivli?
items.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, about 28 km away. We make the equipment there, send it by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

items.q: Can you install playground equipment on a podium slab?
items.a: Yes. On a podium we use the self-standing method so the slab is not drilled for deep foundations, and we usually suggest rubber flooring under the equipment to cushion falls.

Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts. It covers manufacturing defects when the equipment is installed and maintained as per our instructions.

items.q: Our society garden is small. What can fit?
items.a: Share the length and width of the garden and the age of the children who will use it. We will suggest a few pieces or one compact play station and mark the safe play area on a drawing.
